{{Quote|Green grasses beckon, soft and warm<br />My arms will keep you safe from harm<br />As thrantas dance across the sky<br />As stars smile down and south winds sigh<br />The scent of flowers fills the air<br />And sleep comes for Taselda fair&hellip;|Luke Skywalker, singing the lullaby's first stanza to Taselda|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
An ancient '''Alderaanian lullaby''' was known to individuals including [[Taselda]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] and [[Hapan]] descent, and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], a Jedi and [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Music/Legends|song]] was easy to perform for the average [[Parent/Legends|parent]] to their child as it had a gentle melody and a narrow range of notes. Its first stanza mentions [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]], which were [[Species/Legends|creatures]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Alderaan.<ref name="Conviction" />

The lullaby was Taselda's mnemonic key, used by [[Taru Durn]] and other [[Theran Listener]]s to trigger her mesmeric trance during [[mnemotherapy]], while Leia Organa sang the lullaby to her infant children, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. On the world [[Nam Chorios]] in [[44 ABY]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] sang the ancient lullaby to Taselda to invoke the mnemotherapy technique as his old friend had succumbed to the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Conviction" />
